extracted.subtask_description: Reviewing submitted manuscripts for the Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences (PNAS), providing timely, objective, and confidential evaluations of scientific merit, methods, data, and suitability for the journal. Reviewers participate in a consultative peer-review process and must follow ethical and procedural responsibilities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research is well designed and executed
rubrics_metrics.description: Research is well designed and executed

rubrics_metrics.name: Methods permit replication
rubrics_metrics.description: Presentation of methods will permit replication
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reviewers should assess whether the methods are described sufficiently for others to reproduce the work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Data are unambiguous and properly analyzed
rubrics_metrics.description: Data are unambiguous and properly analyzed
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assess clarity of data presentation and whether analyses are appropriate and correctly performed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Conclusions are supported by data
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Verify that the manuscript's conclusions follow from the presented evidence and analyses.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fair and objective evaluation
rubrics_metrics.description: Reviewers should evaluate all submissions fairly, ensuring that assessments are based solely on the content and rigor of the research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reviewer comments and conclusions should be based on an objective and impartial evaluation of the manuscript.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scientific merit
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consider the importance and contribution of the work to its field.

rubrics_metrics.name: Methodology
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluate the appropriateness, rigor, and validity of the experimental or analytical approach.

rubrics_metrics.name: Originality
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assess novelty of the ideas, results, or approaches relative to existing literature.

rubrics_metrics.name: Clarity of writing
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Judge whether the manuscript is clearly written and organized so readers can understand the work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Relevance to scope and purpose of PNAS
rubrics_metrics.description: Relevance to scope and purpose of PNAS
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Determine whether the manuscript fits the journal's mission and will interest its readership.

rubrics_metrics.name: Acting promptly
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reviewers are responsible for responding and performing reviews in a timely manner.

rubrics_metrics.name: Adhere to review instructions
rubrics_metrics.description: Adhering to the instructions for completing a review
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow the journal's specified procedures and guidelines when preparing the review.

rubrics_metrics.name: Meet requested time frame
rubrics_metrics.description: Completing the review within the requested time frame
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submit the review within deadlines communicated by the editor.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide constructive and courteous comments
rubrics_metrics.description: Providing comments to the authors that are constructive and courteous in tone
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Feedback should be helpful, respectful, and aimed at improving the manuscript.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contribute to productive discussion
rubrics_metrics.description: Contributing to a productive discussion of the manuscript
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Engage in the consultative process to help reach a well-reasoned editorial decision.

rubrics_metrics.name: Avoid misuse of privileged information
rubrics_metrics.description: A reviewer should not take scientific, financial, personal, or other advantage of peer review material and should make every effort to avoid even the appearance of impropriety or misuse of information obtained through the review process.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not use unpublished ideas, methods, or results for personal gain; disclose conflicts of interest.

rubrics_metrics.name: Maintain confidentiality of review materials
rubrics_metrics.description: Material under review is a privileged communication that should not be shared or discussed with anyone outside the designated review process unless necessary and approved by the editor.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not share manuscripts, data, or review correspondence outside the authorized review workflow without editor approval.

rubrics_metrics.name: Participate in consultative peer review process
rubrics_metrics.description: PNAS uses a consultative peer review model where reviewers and editors discuss the manuscript before final decisions are made.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Be prepared to engage in reviewer/editor discussions and consider other reviewers' perspectives as part of the decision process.
